# FAIL

## Requirement Summary

"When a Cooling Package is entered and calculations are run, the system must populate the Cooling Circuits, sum the heights of all circuits to set the DX Coil Height in the DX Coil Information, and automatically recompute and update this sum whenever a user edits any Circuit Height."

## Reviewer Findings

- F0 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "The unit of measurement for Circuit Height and DX Coil Height is not specified." | "Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on the required unit of measurement for Circuit Height and DX Coil Height."
- F1 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "Rounding or precision requirements for the summed DX Coil Height are not defined." | "Clarify from the ticket owner the rounding or precision policy to apply to the summed DX Coil Height."
- F2 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "Validation rules for acceptable Circuit Height values (e.g., non‑negative, maximum) are not provided." | "Request the ticket owner to specify validation constraints for Circuit Height values, such as allowed range and sign."
- F3 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "Behavior when Cooling Circuits are added or removed after the initial calculation is not described." | "Clarify how the system should handle addition or removal of Cooling Circuits after the initial sum calculation."
- F4 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "Whether the DX Coil Height field should be editable by the user or strictly read‑only is unclear." | "Obtain clarification on whether the DX Coil Height field is read‑only or can be edited by the user."

## Open Ambiguities

- /ambiguities/0 | "The unit of measurement for Circuit Height and DX Coil Height is not specified."
- /ambiguities/1 | "Rounding or precision requirements for the summed DX Coil Height are not defined."
- /ambiguities/2 | "Validation rules for acceptable Circuit Height values (e.g., non‑negative, maximum) are not provided."
- /ambiguities/3 | "Behavior when Cooling Circuits are added or removed after the initial calculation is not described."
- /ambiguities/4 | "Whether the DX Coil Height field should be editable by the user or strictly read‑only is unclear."

## Final Disposition

FAIL
